messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Investigating tenant billing variance for Horizon Health (enterprise VPC / dedicated pool). Alerts: unusual token accounting spike detected at 17:14 UTC. Suspected customer meter double-counting. Please ack and join thread.

Aisha: acked, I'm oncall. Pulling logs + exporting usage now. Can someone add CSM? @Carlos FYI.

Tom: thx — flagged Carlos. quick question: is Horizon on a shared routing fallback policy or pinned to a model?

Aisha: They’re pinned to dedicated gpus but have a fallback configured to a quantized variant in the same pool.

Priya: jumping in — billing telemetry shows a ~3.4x jump in billed tokens vs actual successful responses for the last 2h. raw export attached in workspace.

Jon: I’m seeing repeated request retries in the runtime logs around 17:10-17:22 for that tenant. Retries include full token accounting on retry path. snippet:```
2026-02-14T17:11:03Z INFO request_id=rc-... tenant=horizon request_id_parent=... model=redwood-13b-q retry=1 tokens_charged=842
2026-02-14T17:11:03Z INFO request_id=rc-... tenant=horizon request_id_parent=... model=redwood-13b-q retry=2 tokens_charged=842
```
Looks like the retry handler is emitting charge events twice.

Aisha: ok that explains spike. Is this limited to Horizon?

Priya: initial query across tenants for that timeframe:```
SELECT tenant, SUM(charged_tokens) as billed FROM usage_events WHERE day='2026-02-14' AND hour BETWEEN 17 AND 18 GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY billed DESC LIMIT 10;
-- result shows Horizon + small set of tenants that hit the fallback path concurrently
```
Horizon is the biggest hit (~+2.1M extra tokens).

Lena: Billing ops — can we pause billing ingestion for Horizon while we validate? We need to avoid further overcharging while we investigate.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline note: manual freeze for tenant is supported via admin API. Use POST /admin/tenants/{tenant}/billing/actions with body {"action":"freeze_ingest"}. Requires billing-admin role. Audit trail will be created.

Aisha: Tom, can you run the freeze? I'll keep triage running.

Tom: doing it now. curl -X POST "$ADMIN_API/tenants/horizon-billing/actions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"action":"freeze_ingest"}'
Tom: response 202 accepted. billing-bot: please confirm ingest is paused.

billing-bot: Ingest freeze accepted. Current queued events for Horizon will be retained but not applied to billable counters.

Carlos: CSM here — I’m drafting a customer-facing note and will escalate to their ops. Do we have an ETA for root cause and expected credit amount estimate?

Priya: preliminary delta = 2,127,432 tokens over 2 hours. At their rate (~$0.0004/token) rough overcharge ~ $850. Will refine after dedupe and replay.

Jon: mitigation work: patch ready to stop double-emitting charge events on retry. I can hotfix the runtime on the affected pool now. Impact: short rolling restart of pods in dedicated pool (expected 90s per node). Any objections?

Aisha: go ahead with canary on one node. Coordinate with Tom for traffic draining. Prioritize minimal customer disruption; we already froze billing.

Tom: canary deploy started to pool node-12. logs look clean so far. No new duplicate charge events observed for canary traffic.

Jon: rolling patch across pool now. Progress: node-12 ✅ node-13 ✅ node-14 in progress.

Priya: re-running billing delta query with dedupe logic:```
-- de-dup by request_parent_id to avoid retries being counted twice
SELECT request_parent_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM raw_charges WHERE day='2026-02-14' GROUP BY request_parent_id HAVING SUM(tokens) > 0;
-- recompute billed tokens for Horizon => corrected delta ~ 1,990,200 tokens (revised)
```

Carlos: thanks — that's helpful for the customer note. I'll propose an initial credit of $800 and follow up after final audit.

Lena: operations task list: 1) freeze ingest (done) 2) runtime patch (in progress) 3) replay raw events against dedupe logic to compute final credit 4) issue credit + update invoice 5) postmortem + follow-up with product for long-term fix (prevent retry-only accounting).

Aisha: agree. Assigning owners: replay -> Priya, credit issuance -> Lena, postmortem -> Jon, customer comms -> Carlos.

Tom: runtime rolling patch complete across pool. Verified no duplicate charge logs for new traffic.

billing-bot: Billing export for Horizon prepared: location: gs://billing-exports/horizon/2026-02-14-17-18.ndjson.gz (sha256: 0fa3...).

Priya: starting replay now. ETA ~30m for full dedupe + reconciliation.

Jon: opened postmortem draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/issues/412 — added timeline + logs. Please add notes as you go.

Aisha: handing off to Tom for second-oncall; I need to step away for 15m. Tom, please monitor replay and confirm final numbers.

Tom: ack takeover. Monitoring replay. Priya, ping me if you need data slices.

Priya: replay complete. Final corrected overcount for Horizon = 1,985,740 tokens. Final estimated credit $794.30. Uploading reconciliation CSV to the export bucket.

Lena: billing ops - issuing credit now and updating invoice. Transaction id: cr-20260214-0897. Carlos, I'll DM you the customer-facing credit receipt once generated.

Carlos: thanks — I'll send an interim note to the customer: short summary, that we've frozen ingest, applied credit, patch deployed, postmortem forthcoming. Will include contact for escalation.

Aisha: back oncall. Thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: 1) prod runtime patch to include a unit test to prevent double-charge on retry (Jon) 2) add a monitoring alert for charge event surges correlated with retry counts (Tom) 3) billing guardrails: auto-freeze threshold for >1M token delta in 1h window (Lena/Product).

Jon: noted, I'll add tests + PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345

Tom: I'll create an alert rule and a runbook entry in the SRE wiki.

Lena: filing billing guardrail feature request to product.

incident-bot: Incident closed for customer-impacting billing variance (Horizon Health). Severity lowered to S2 post-mitigation. Postmortem required.

Carlos: will follow up with customer comms + shared postmortem once it's ready.

Aisha: final status: ingest unfrozen after replay? (should we unfreeze?)

billing-bot: Unfreeze recommended after final reconciliation confirmed. Unfreeze executed at 17:46 UTC.

Aisha: thanks all — closing thread. Action items captured in the GitHub issue and the billing ops ticket.
